'''Aubrey''' is a male student of the Department of Light Energy Sciences, seen lecturing his classmate, '''Hedlus'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Aubrey:''' So this is your new master plan for the semester?
:'''Hedlus:''' Why? Isn't it comprehensive? 
:'''Aubrey:''' You want to juggle coursework, health, research, club activities...
:'''Aubrey:''' ...What are you, a thousand-armed [[Chop Chop]]?
:'''Hedlus:''' A Huanglong proverb said it best, "Aim high and you will shoot the middle. Aim for the middle and will shoot the ground. A determined heart can achieve anything, so let your resolve take root today."
:'''Aubrey:''' Funny how you skipped the part before that, "Study now, lest you regret it later." How about you retake the courses you failed last semester first?
:'''Hedlus:''' Come on, give me a break...
{{Dialogue End}}
